de1.P1.C2.ly_do: Chi $y=7x+5$ co dang $y=ax+b$ voi $a\ne 0$; $y=3-x^2$ bac hai, $f(x)=30/x$ va $g(x)=(19x+7)/\sqrt{x}$ khong phai bac nhat.

de1.P1.C8.ly_do: $3x-2x=3x+1$ tuc $x=3x+1$; cong ca hai ve voi $-3x$ duoc $-2x=1$.
